name: Universal Human Remote Control Interface
human_description: Establish an automatic, server-originated notification, briefing, and control system between WebOS and the user's phone over Tailscale private networking.
requirements: Automatic server-push briefing to Digital Butler front page upon mission receipt, progress, completion, or failure
Briefing delivery system operates independently of whether Tailcat is open
Persistent delivery ledger tracking PENDING, SENT, DELIVERED, and ACKNOWLEDGED states with offline phone queue recovery
Phone natural language commands executed safely under PrimeGate governance
constraints: Zero loss of historical mission/gap records upon device reboot or WebOS restart
architectural_intent: Event-driven push architecture over Tailscale overlay with durable delivery tracking and decoupled front-page summary vs. Tailcat detail views.
